--a गण of कार्दवेय Na1gas inhabiting महातल, afraid only of गरुड. Fought with Rudras in देवासुर battle. भा. V. २४-29; VIII. १०. ३४. [page१-483+ २९]

--a daughter of दक्ष and one of कश्य- pa's wives, and mother of दन्दशूक and other serpents.
1: भा.

. २६ and २८; वा. ६६. ५४.
Her twelve daughters were married to Pulaha. भूतस्, पिशाचस्, Kinnaras, वानरस् and others belonged to her line.
